entities.summary: Sony Lab'ou Tansi (b. 1947-06-05, Kimwenza) was a author or novelist of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kimwenza and Democratic Republic of the Congo. Known in the fields of democratic republic of the congo, authors & novelists, africa.
